query: SELECT count(*) AS "charges!", count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments.ledger_entry r WHERE r.kind = 'refund' AND r.job_id = e.job_id AND r.business_id = e.business_id)) AS "refunded!", count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments.ledger_entry d WHERE d.kind = 'dispute' AND d.job_id = e.job_id AND d.business_id = e.business_id)) AS "disputed!" FROM payments.ledger_entry e WHERE e.kind = 'charge' AND e.job_id = ANY($1) AND e.recorded_at >= $2 AND e.recorded_at < $3
